episodes.name: The Death Row Convict and the Executioner
episodes.overview: Gabimaru, a ninja member of a clan of assassins, is sentenced to death. He claims to have nothing to tie him to life, yet no method of execution manages to end his life. His meeting with Sagiri Yamada Asaemon, who seems to be investigating him, will change everything.

episodes.name: Screening and Choosing
episodes.overview: Gabimaru is introduced to the shogun along with other criminals selected to travel by boat to the Divine Land to search for the elixir of immortality. Under the supervision of the samurai of the Yamada clan, they are told the rules that will govern their journey, before moving on to the brutal selection of participants.

episodes.name: Weakness and Strength
episodes.overview: The death row inmates and their guards enter the mystical island, where magnificent flowers grow and unusual insects swarm around. But there isn't much time to admire the scenery, as some criminals don't intend to play by the rules.

episodes.name: Hell and Paradise
episodes.overview: Gabimaru and Sagiri are in trouble during their first fight against the island's mysterious creatures. Gabimaru is unaware of these monstrosities and this puts him at a disadvantage in battle. The sudden arrival of Yuzuriha, the female ninja, will change the situation, but Gabimaru does not see clearly in her game.

episodes.name: The Samurai and the Woman
episodes.overview: Sagiri comes to her senses in a cave on the island. His companions share their knowledge of the island to determine what to do next. As they prepare to spend the night, Genji, one of the samurai, offers Sagiri to leave the island on his boat, claiming that this mission is not suitable for a woman like her.

episodes.name: Heart and Reason
episodes.overview: Rokurota starts to cause serious problems for Sagiri and Gabimaru, and now they must think of a strategy to defeat him!

episodes.name: Flowers and Offerings
episodes.overview: Sagiri and Gabimaru's group discovers a village that turns out not to be completely abandoned, and Chobe and Toma stumble upon some beings that turn out not to be angelic.

episodes.name: Student and Master
episodes.overview: Tenza and Nurugai continue their inspection of the coasts in order to find a current which would allow a boat to move away from the island, but they come face to face with an Eternal. They manage to get away and meet Shion, the master of Tenza at the Asaemon.

episodes.name: Gods and People
episodes.overview: Gabimaru leaves his group behind to go to Hôrai to find the elixir. But a door stands between him and his objective, and to cross it he must face Zhu Jin, one of the Eternals.

episodes.name: Yin and Yang
episodes.overview: Gabimaru finds himself face to face with Gantetsusai and Fuchi Yamada Asaemon.  He knows that the fight will be tough and prefers to change strategy to keep his chances of finding the elixir.  In Sagiri's group, Senta uses the information given by Hôko to refine his vision of the island.

episodes.name: Weak and Strong
episodes.overview: After Chobe and Toma, it's the turn of Gabimaru's group to come face to face with a monk. The latter asks Mei to follow him to return to a place he calls the “palace”. When the monk explains what he intends to do to the girl, Gabimaru and Gantetsusai decide to protect her, even if it goes against the habits of the ninja.

episodes.name: Umbrella and Ink
episodes.overview: Barely arriving in Horai, Sagiri, Yuzuriha, and Senta find themselves facing a Tensen. He makes them a revelation that will question the purpose of their mission, but before thinking about what's next, they must find a way to eliminate this impressive enemy.

episodes.name: Dreams and Reality
episodes.overview: Aided by Sagiri and Nurugai, Shion faces the Celestial Guru Mu Dan in his Kishikai form, armed with his knowledge of wave management and the Tao. Meanwhile, Gabimaru reawakens in a remote cave with no memory of what happened...

episodes.name: Dawn and Confusion
episodes.overview: Shugen and Jikka are sent to Shinsenkyo, while Gabimaru and his companions battle Aza Chobe and Toma.

episodes.name: Reality and Fantasy
episodes.overview: Aza Chobe and Gabimaru lose themselves in battle, but Mei stops their fight.

episodes.name: Immutability and Change
episodes.overview: While Aza Chobe battles Rien, Gabimaru regains his memories and begins training in the use of tao.

episodes.name: The Samurai Code and Carnage
episodes.overview: Sagiri believes Shugen will be an ally and eagerly anticipates the expedition's arrival, but Shion is skeptical.

episodes.name: Humans and Sages
episodes.overview: As the expeditioners prepare, Gabimaru asks Mei if she's sure she wants to leave the island with them.

episodes.name: Conflict and Growing Together
episodes.overview: Gabimaru's group finally enters the sacred mountain, but the Tensen can see everything they're up to.

episodes.name: Two People and One Person
episodes.overview: Gantetsusai and Fuchi struggle against Tao Fa, but they seem to be enjoying themselves.

episodes.name: Chrysanthemum and Peach
episodes.overview: When Tao Fa asks Ju Fa for help, Ju Fa recalls the time they spent together.
